user_query: I'm organizing a tech conference in San Francisco and I'm in need of some job stories from YC Hacker news official to include in my presentation. Can you provide me with the latest job stories related to technology and software engineering? Additionally, categorize the job titles mentioned in these stories to get an idea of the different roles available. Also, retrieve the LD details for an employee with the ID '12345' using the LD API.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest job stories related to technology and software engineering from YC Hacker News.
Categorize the job titles mentioned in the fetched job stories to identify different technology roles.
Retrieve the LD details for an employee with the ID '12345' using the LD API.
